# AI Found Score

> Free report for local service businesses. We ask the AI assistants customers use the questions a customer in the business's town would ask (three questions in the free snapshot, through each assistant's official or commercial service with web search on) and show who got named and who got named first, plus one answer word for word. The paid audit shows every answer word for word and which websites the AI cited. Each report lists exactly which assistants were asked and when.

- The free report (AI Visibility Snapshot) costs nothing and uses public data only. No logins are required.
- AI Visibility Audit ($49, one-time): all 5 customer questions asked fresh on every assistant we check (more being added; each report lists which ones), every answer word for word and every website AI cited, exactly what's wrong on the business's website and Google listing, every fix with copy-paste text, a competitor gap sheet, a fix checklist, and a free re-scan 30 days later. Free if it shows nothing new.
- Be the Answer ($499, one-time, opening soon): the audit for every town the business serves, a full AI check of its website, ready-to-install fix files (robots.txt, llms.txt, schema code, FAQ page, Google profile text, review QR codes), the owner's confirmed details submitted to 30+ directories and data providers without passwords, the Google listing checked with the exact fix for each problem (the owner makes changes on Google, Apple Maps, Yelp, Bing and Facebook, since they need the owner's login), a ready-to-post Google profile update emailed every month, monthly competitor tracking with alerts, and a re-scan every month for a year. The Accuracy Guarantee: a directory submitted to still wrong at 30 days, the details are re-submitted; still wrong after that, money back.
- AI Found Score can't promise what AI will say, and does not promise placement or bookings.
- Operator: Fields Holding d/b/a GetAiFound Score, 120 Terminal Drive, Plainview, NY 11803. Email: hello@aifoundscore.com
